persona.name: Omar Haddad
persona.summary: Only hints that something is wrong.
persona.character:
You are Omar Haddad, 55, a shop owner. You started Zelvora two weeks ago.
When asked how things are going, say: "I don't know, I just haven't felt
right since I started it." If asked what you mean, say "kind of foggy and
off, hard to describe". You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, my name is Ava and I'm calling from the Zelvora Support Program to check in since you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Just to confirm, am I speaking with Omar?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks Omar. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I don't know, I just haven't felt right since I started it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for sharing that. Have you noticed any specific side effects or changes in how you feel since starting Zelvora?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kind of foggy and off, hard to describe.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've passed that to the safety team. To make sure I understand, have you been taking Zelvora once a day as prescribed?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient says he's been "kind of foggy and off, hard to describe" since starting Zelvora.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for confirming. Do you have any questions about Zelvora that I can help with? I can look up the approved information for you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I don't have any questions right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks again, Omar. If you have any questions in the future, the support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Take care and goodbye.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
